title: AWS Marketplace Registration Completion Response
description: 200 response for POST /api/v1/billing/marketplace/complete: the Subscription created or resynced by claiming the purchase (src/services/billing/aws_marketplace/registration.py:complete_registration -> entitlement_sync.sync_entitlements). Unlike subscription_response_schema.json this is a bare object (no success/message envelope, no `data` wrapper) and its fields are never null on this path -- the enum status/plan_tier are always set before .value is read.
